business_problem: Santander sought to validate the operational and control framework for AI agents to initiate and complete customer payments within its regulated payment environment, with predefined limits and permissions and security, privacy, and consumer-protection safeguards.
solution_summary: Banco Santander ran the pilot in a controlled environment within its regulated payment framework. An AI agent initiated and executed a payment on behalf of a customer under predefined limits and permissions. Mastercard Agent Pay integrated AI agents into the payment flow as visible, governed participants, enabling interaction with issuers, acquirers and merchants; the transaction was processed through Santander’s live payments infrastructure to validate the end-to-end operational and control framework under real conditions. PayOS supported end-to-end orchestration. The source does not identify the agent model, input-data ingestion, processing internals, storage tier, or settlement path, and does not describe specific merchant or network endpoints. It characterizes this as a pilot rather than a commercial rollout; extended testing and scaling are planned with controls, resilience and regulatory alignment maintained.
